subject: Change in definition of figure captions and labels

messages.author: 87e020c3fd9325fa
messages.subject: Change in definition of figure captions and labels
parts:
Hi,
I have recently updated to knitr v1.5.  I seem to be unable to produce figure captions or labels anymore.  In previous versions of Knitr, it used to be that the  options fig.lp or fig.cap would appear as options when defining a new chunk.  They no longer appear.  Second, the output pdf produces a figure with no caption or label. 

Toy example below, produces a pdf, but gives two warnings about undefined references.  As well, i notice a 'Luatex not detected'.

I am using R(3.1.0), RStudio(0.98.507) and recently installed MacTex.

Many thanks for the package, and any suggestions on a solution. 

\documentclass{article}

\begin{document}
\SweaveOpts{concordance=TRUE}

Here is a figure
<<afigure, fig=TRUE, fig.cap="the figure has a caption">>=
plot(1:10, runif(10,0,1))
@

My figure \ref{fig:afigure} has no label or caption

\end{document}
